title: Proverbs Chapter 19 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 19 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 19 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 19.

questions.question: What is better according to Proverbs 19:1?
options: A wealthy man with perverse lips
A man who hasteth with his feet
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:1 states that 'Better is the poor that walketh in his integrity...' indicating that integrity is more valuable than wealth with bad character.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:2, what is not good for the soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:2 explicitly says, 'Also, that the soul be without knowledge, it is not good;' highlighting the importance of knowledge.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:3 say about the foolishness of man?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:3 states, 'The foolishness of man perverteth his way...' emphasizing the negative impact of foolishness.

questions.question: What does wealth do according to Proverbs 19:4?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:4 says, 'Wealth maketh many friends; but the poor is separated from his neighbour,' indicating how wealth influences relationships.

questions.question: What will happen to a false witness according to Proverbs 19:5?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:5 declares, 'A false witness shall not be unpunished,' emphasizing the consequences of lying.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:6, who will many seek favor from?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:6 states, 'Many will intreat the favour of the prince...' indicating that people seek favor from those in power.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 19:7 states that the brethren of the poor do love him.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:7 says, 'All the brethren of the poor do hate him...' indicating a lack of love from his brethren.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 19:8, he that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:8 states, 'He that getteth wisdom loveth his own soul...' affirming the value of wisdom.

questions.question: What is said about a fool in Proverbs 19:10?
options: Delight is not seemly for him
questions.correctAnswer: Delight is not seemly for him
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:10 states, 'Delight is not seemly for a fool...' indicating that a fool does not deserve joy.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:11, what is a man's discretion able to do?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:11 says, 'The discretion of a man deferreth his anger...' highlighting the importance of self-control.

questions.question: In Proverbs 19, which instruction comes before all the others listed here?
options: The king's wrath is like a lion
Better is the poor with integrity
He that getteth wisdom loveth his soul
questions.correctAnswer: Better is the poor with integrity
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:1 is the first verse of the chapter, establishing the initial theme of integrity over wealth.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 19:3 states that a man's heart fretteth against the LORD.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:3 mentions, 'his heart fretteth against the LORD,' affirming the truth of the statement.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 19:12 compares the king's favour to the dew upon the grass.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:12 states, 'his favour is as dew upon the grass,' making this statement true.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 19 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 19 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What is the result of a man's discretion according to Proverbs 19:11?
options: It causes him to be alone
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:11 states that 'The discretion of a man deferreth his anger; and it is his glory to pass over a transgression.' This shows that having discretion allows a man to control his anger and respond nobly to offenses.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:12, how does a king's favor compare to his wrath?
options: Favor is like a lion's roar
Favor is like dew upon grass
Wrath is like dew upon grass
questions.correctAnswer: Favor is like dew upon grass
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:12 compares the king's favor to 'dew upon the grass,' indicating that his favor brings refreshment and blessings, contrasting with the danger of his wrath, which is compared to 'the roaring of a lion.'

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:13 say about a foolish son?
options: He is a blessing to his father
He is the calamity of his father
He brings joy to the household
questions.correctAnswer: He is the calamity of his father
questions.explanation: According to Proverbs 19:13, 'A foolish son is the calamity of his father,' illustrating the serious consequences of foolishness in family relationships.

questions.question: What inheritance do fathers leave according to Proverbs 19:14?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:14 states, 'House and riches are the inheritance of fathers,' indicating the material legacy passed down, but it also contrasts with the spiritual inheritance of a prudent wife from the LORD.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:15 say about slothfulness?
options: It casts into a deep sleep
questions.correctAnswer: It casts into a deep sleep
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:15 declares, 'Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger,' highlighting the consequences of laziness.

questions.question: What is promised in Proverbs 19:16 for those who keep the commandment?
options: They will keep their own soul
They will be favored by others
questions.correctAnswer: They will keep their own soul
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:16 states, 'He that keepeth the commandment keepeth his own soul,' indicating that obedience to God's commandments is essential for spiritual well-being.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:17 say about lending to the poor?
options: It is an act of kindness towards the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: It is an act of kindness towards the LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:17 states, 'He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again,' indicating that helping the poor is a way of serving God.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:18, what should parents do while there is hope?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:18 says, 'Chasten thy son while there is hope, and let not thy soul spare for his crying,' emphasizing the importance of discipline in raising children.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:19 say about a man of great wrath?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:19 states, 'A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment: for if thou deliver him, yet thou must do it again,' indicating that a quick temper leads to negative consequences.

questions.question: What is the advice given in Proverbs 19:20 regarding counsel?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:20 instructs, 'Hear counsel, and receive instruction, that thou mayest be wise in thy latter end,' emphasizing the importance of seeking wisdom through guidance.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 19:21, the counsel of the LORD will not stand against a man's devices.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:21 states, 'There are many devices in a man's heart; nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand.' This means that human plans are subject to failure, but God's counsel will prevail.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 19:23 confirms that the fear of the LORD leads to life and satisfaction.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:23 states, 'The fear of the LORD tendeth to life: and he that hath it shall abide satisfied; he shall not be visited with evil,' indicating that reverence for God leads to a fulfilling life.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 19:25, smiting a scorner will make the simple beware.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:25 states, 'Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware: and reprove one that hath understanding, and he will understand knowledge,' emphasizing the value of correction.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 19 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 19.

questions.question: What is said about the counsel of the LORD in relation to a man's heart?
questions.explanation: The verse states, 'nevertheless the counsel of the LORD, that shall stand' indicating that despite many devices in a man's heart, God's counsel is unchanging and authoritative.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered better than a liar according to Proverbs 19:22?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:22 states, 'a poor man is better than a liar,' highlighting the value of honesty over wealth.

questions.question: What does the fear of the LORD tend to, as stated in Proverbs 19:23?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:23 explains that 'the fear of the LORD tendeth to life,' suggesting a protective and life-giving quality of revering God.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:24, what does a slothful man do?
options: Hides his hand in his bosom
questions.correctAnswer: Hides his hand in his bosom
questions.explanation: The verse illustrates the laziness of a slothful man who 'hideth his hand in his bosom,' indicating his unwillingness to even feed himself.

questions.question: What is the consequence for a son who wasteth his father and chaseth away his mother, according to Proverbs 19:26?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:26 states that such a son 'is a son that causeth shame, and bringeth reproach,' indicating the severe social consequences of his actions.

questions.question: What should one do according to Proverbs 19:27?
options: Cease to hear instruction that causeth to err
questions.correctAnswer: Cease to hear instruction that causeth to err
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:27 advises to 'cease... to hear the instruction that causeth to err from the words of knowledge,' emphasizing the importance of discerning good instruction.

questions.question: What literary device is evident in Proverbs 19:25 with the phrase 'Smite a scorner, and the simple will beware'?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:25 employs parallelism, presenting two related statements that reinforce each other, highlighting the effects of correction on different types of people.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:18, when should one chasten their son?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:18 indicates that one should 'chasten thy son while there is hope,' stressing the urgency and importance of discipline during formative years.

questions.question: What is said about a false witness in Proverbs 19:9?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:9 asserts that 'A false witness shall not be unpunished,' reinforcing the moral principle that lying has consequences.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 19:19 states that a man of great wrath shall suffer punishment.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:19 clearly states, 'A man of great wrath shall suffer punishment,' indicating the consequences of uncontrolled anger.

questions.question: True or False: The desire of a man is his deceit, according to Proverbs 19:22.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:22 states, 'The desire of a man is his kindness,' contrasting kindness with deceit.

questions.question: Which New Testament verse echoes the theme of a man's heart being full of devices, similar to Proverbs 19:21?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 17:9 states, 'The heart is deceitful above all things,' which aligns with the idea in Proverbs 19:21 that many devices (plans) exist in a man's heart.

questions.question: Which verse from Proverbs emphasizes the importance of wisdom, connecting it to Proverbs 19:8?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 3:13 states, 'Happy is the man that findeth wisdom,' which connects to Proverbs 19:8 emphasizing the value of acquiring wisdom.

questions.question: What is the Hebrew meaning of the word 'wisdom' found in Proverbs 19:8?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word for 'wisdom' in Proverbs 19:8 is 'Chokmah,' which signifies skill, intelligence, and the ability to make sound judgments.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 19 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 19 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:1 teach about integrity compared to wealth?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:1 states that it is better to be poor and walk in integrity than to be perverse and foolish, highlighting the value of integrity over wealth.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:2, what is not good for the soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:2 indicates that a soul lacking knowledge is not good, emphasizing the necessity of understanding for a fulfilling life.

questions.question: What consequence does Proverbs 19:5 state for a false witness?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:5 asserts that a false witness shall not go unpunished, indicating the seriousness of bearing false witness.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 19:8 relate wisdom to one's soul?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:8 states that he who gets wisdom loves his own soul, highlighting the intrinsic value of wisdom for personal well-being.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:11 suggest about a man's discretion?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:11 teaches that a man's discretion can defer anger, showcasing the virtue of patience and self-control.

questions.question: In Proverbs 19:12, how is the king's wrath described?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:12 compares the king's wrath to the roaring of a lion, indicating its powerful and fearsome nature.

questions.question: What is the relationship between a foolish son and his father according to Proverbs 19:13?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:13 states that a foolish son is the calamity of his father, illustrating the distress that foolishness can bring to a family.

questions.question: Which of the following is considered an inheritance from fathers in Proverbs 19:14?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:14 specifies that house and riches are the inheritance of fathers, contrasting material wealth with spiritual blessings.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:17 say about lending to the poor?
options: It is lending to the LORD
questions.correctAnswer: It is lending to the LORD
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:17 indicates that he who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD, emphasizing the spiritual significance of helping those in need.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:21 imply about the counsel of the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:21 teaches that while a man's heart may devise many plans, it is the counsel of the LORD that ultimately prevails, highlighting God's sovereignty.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:22 say about the desire of a man?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:22 states that the desire of a man is his kindness, indicating that true desire aligns with benevolence toward others.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 19:23, what is the result of fearing the LORD?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:23 teaches that the fear of the LORD leads to life and satisfaction, pointing to the holistic well-being found in reverence for God.

questions.question: What principle about slothfulness is given in Proverbs 19:24?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:24 illustrates the slothful man hiding his hand in his bosom and not bringing it to his mouth, indicating a refusal to act and the consequences of idleness.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 19:26 say about a son who wastes his father?
options: He is a source of pride
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:26 asserts that a son who wastes his father and chases away his mother brings shame and reproach, emphasizing the importance of respect and responsibility within family dynamics.

questions.question: What warning does Proverbs 19:27 give about instruction?
options: To stop listening to harmful instruction
questions.correctAnswer: To stop listening to harmful instruction
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:27 advises to cease listening to instruction that leads one away from knowledge, underscoring the importance of discerning valuable teachings.
